title: ConnectionError in oauth.callback when refreshing an expired session
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Running Lattice 3.1.6 on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS against ap-south-1.

STEPS:

Steps to reproduce:
- Start by refreshing an expired session.
- Upgrade from the previous release and keep the old settings.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

As on every earlier run, refreshing an expired session should just complete.

ACTUAL:

Every attempt has failed since we upgraded. It began right after upgrading to
this release; nothing else changed.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:125 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:57 in start
lattice/auth/oauth.py:108 in callback
ConnectionError: connection reset by peer (host=ap-south-1)
